provider: NASA Mars 2020 Rover PLACES / PDS Geosciences Node
coordinate_system: planetocentric latitude, east-positive longitude; Mars radius 3396.19 km for distance
position_uncertainty: The table supplies localized coordinates but no per-position uncertainty field in this ENOM ingest.
known_source_gap: PDS Release 16 notes that ROVER,n,0 entries are absent from best_tactical.csv; those positions are represented by SITE rows, so ENOM's drive-position subset does not include them.
interpretation_limit: Positions are selected best-tactical rover localizations associated with drive records. They are discrete location fixes, not a continuous wheel path, odometry track, hazard assessment, or vehicle-suitability result. Release 16 omits ROVER,n,0 fixes from this table, leaving a gap at those drive starts.
